name: Tsundere★S Otome -Sweet Sweet Sweet-
original_name: ツンデレ★Ｓ乙女 ―sweet sweet sweet―
source:
After Iori was dumped by her boyfriend, she decides to go on a diet and have cosmetic surgery. Though her appearance has been greatly changed, she is still shy. One day, she decides to join a club called the "Three S Club". There are a lot of handsome members in the club, but she will need to pass the test to join them. Although many girls have failed the test, she easily passes it. As a matter of fact, the purpose of the club is to go time traveling. According to them, Iori also has a special power. Along with the unique members of the club her life gradually changes...

[From Eroge Shop]
translation:
伊织被男友抛弃后，决定减肥并接受整容。虽然外貌发生了巨大变化，她依然十分害羞。一天，她决定加入名为"Three S Club"的社团。俱乐部里有许多英俊成员，但想加入必须通过测试。尽管许多女孩都没能过关，她却轻松合格。实际上，这个社团的目的是进行时间旅行。据成员们所说，伊织也拥有特殊能力。随着她与个性十足的社员们相处，生活逐渐发生改变…
